title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - Ecosystem
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/Ecosystem. Description of an ecosystem including a (formal) representation of its trust profile. The (subject) identifier of an RDF resource of this type is understood to be the ecosystem's ID so should be chosen with care. Subclass of GaiaXEntity per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the GaiaXEntity model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Ecosystem'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

ecoTrustScope.description: Relationship. The trust scope(s) recognized within this ecosystem. Links to one or more EcoTrustScope entities.
